PRODUCTS & SERVICES

Bathroom Remodeling

Bathroom Remodeling

Our bathroom remodeling, designs, and renovation services will turn your average bathroom into a sleek and sophisticated shower room that friends and family will enjoy for many years.

Kitchen Remodeling

Kitchen Remodeling

Kitchen remodeling at its finest. Our kitchen design and renovation services will leave your Michigan home looking like a Pinterest picture. Only in real life, not pinned on a board!

Glass Shower Doors

Glass Shower Doors

Nobody does glass shower doors better than “Designs In Glass”. Our frameless, seamless, euro shower doors are top notch and we know you will love them. Say goodbye to pesky shower curtain rods and hangers!

Countertops

Custom Countertops

Our custom made countertops come in all types of material. Granite, quartz, butcher block and more. The is no space in your kitchen, bathroom, island, or home that we cannot design/install the perfect countertops for.

Cabinets

Custom Cabinets

Whether you are looking for new modern design cabinets, or want to bring back the down home country feel. Our custom cabinets will be designed to fit your space and gone style perfectly.

Flooring, Tiles & Lights

Tiling & Lighting

Nothing adds the finishing touches to your home space like good ‘ol floor tiles and lighting. We have everything from ceramic tiles to hardwood floors, hanging lights and recessed lighting.

PINTEREST QUALITY BATHROOM & KITCHEN REMODELING.
		
GET A QUOTE
WHY CHOOSE US?
30 YEARS EXPERIENCE

We have been doing this for a long time. Our 30 years of experience ensures that you will get quality products and service every time.

BBB ACCREDITED

We are proud to be accredited by the Better Business Bureau with an outstanding A+ reading. What more could you ask for?

WE GOT HOWARD!

It is no secret that Howard Emmer is one of the most trusted name in Michigan bathroom and kitchen remodeling. You will get 1-on-1 service from Howard every time.

COMPETITIVE PRICING

We may not be the cheapest option at times, but we always keep competitive pricing as a top priority. This is to ensure that you get maximum value for your project.

2 YEAR WARRANTY

All of our remodeling and renovation projects come with our two (2) year workmanship warranty to make sure that your project looks new long after the initial install.

PROVEN REPUTATION

A quick search online will show that our previous customers loved working with us. We are certain that you will share that same love!

MORE ABOUT US

Designs in Glass has been the leading company providing bathroom remodeling services and glass shower door installation in Michigan for many years! Our seamless and frameless glass shower doors have been proven to be the most sophisticated and elegant shower doors available in today’s bathroom remodeling industry!

If you are searching for new glass shower doors and/or bathroom & kitchen remodeling in Southeast Michigan, we are certain that you will be 100% satisfied when selecting Designs in Glass for your next project! Our extensive referral base comes from devoted customer service to our homeowners, contractors, tile shops and interior designers

Our custom wood cabinets, granite countertops and and frameless glass shower doors are the key elements that set us apart from other kitchen and bathroom remodeling contractors in Michigan. We also install ceramic floor tiling and custom lighting to make your bathroom and kitchen a spectacular room that attracts many comments and attention from your friends and family.

Designs in Glass conveniently services a great majority of Southeast Michigan and the Metro Detroit area. Including these counties: Wayne County, Oakland County. Macomb County, Livingston County, Washtenaw County, Lapear County, Genesee County and St. Clair County.

Let us make your next remodeling project a good one by demonstrating our reputation and experience to you. We are ready and waiting to become your kitchen and bathroom remodeling contractors in Michigan!

30 YEARS EXPERIENCE

With over 30 years of experience in providing bathroom and kitchen remodeling services. You will receive the quality and assurance that you need when working with a contractor.

BBB ACCREDITED. A+ RATING.

We take great pride on having a good reputation. In addition to our great rating and accreditation with the Better Business Bureau, we have many happy customers that would love to tell you how great their experience was when working with our company.

2 YEAR WORKMANSHIP WARRANTY

We warranty all of our workmanship for 2 years. This is to ensure that your remodeling project stays looking new long after the initial installation.

YOU GET HOWARD!

It is no secret that Howard Emmer (owner of Designs in Glass) is one of the leading names in Michigan kitchen & bathroom remodeling. You will get 1-on-1 service from Howard every time!

	
CUSTOMER TESTIMONIALS

I met Howard only to do a single shower door and once I found out his company does all renovations inside we signed contract to do 2 of my bathrooms for complete makeover. I let him in on my vision and he found all the fixtures for the house and did a great job. Howard was full of ideas and helped with design to accomplish turning my entire house into my forever home. I have referred many of my friends and all have had same experience with Howard/ Bob and entire crew.

Veena K.
Rochester Hills, MI
	

Designs in Glass/Specialty Kitchen and Bath redid my entire condo and fulfilled all my wishes to the letter. It was a major makeover throughout entire condo, new kitchen , bathrooms, custom flooring and finish paint. I am so pleased to find Howard and his company and recommend to all my friends and family. Thank you thank you Custom service is alive and well with companies like his.

Anthony P.
Bloomfield Hills, MI
	

I had you remodel both my bathrooms as soon as I talked to some of your references I needed to get a hold of you to get these project done in timely manner. Once agreed on spec/design and I decided to supply all material the projects came out great. Thanks again Howard, enjoy the dream cruise. My corvette is still for sale???

David R.
Warren, MI
	

Once your company and yourself provided us with a great bathroom and family room renovation few years ago, both my wife and I knew you would be our only choice for a very special master bathroom makeover. All your help and guidance for us to find all the materials we wanted to select, the major makeover went like clockwork to a finish product that is so beautiful and everything we could ask for.

Paer and Ninna M.
Bloomfield Hills, MI

Howard just wanted to thank you where most contractors were not interested in such a small job with such a small bathroom, you took on our project and did exactly what we needed and in a budget we could afford.Thanks again.

Chuck and Donna W.
Garden City, MI
	

We love our new bathroom renovation and look forward when we ready for our next project. Howard, your our first and only phone call after this project went so professionally.

Darryl and Linda D.
Macomb, MI
	

Though we had little language barrier we all were able to complete my major kitchen/living room makeover and make everyone happy in the family. It was a lot of detail, especially me being an engineer, but everything and every detail was done to perfection. Thanks again Howard, Bob and your crew.

Atsumasa K.
Northville, MI
	

I got a custom shower door order from design in glass for our shower. Great communication, estimates, pricing and installation. Got it done in summer 2023. Very Professional. Highly recommend them.

Maha Komar
5 STAR GOOGLE RATING

GRANITE COUNTERTOP INSTALLATION IN SOUTHEAST MICHIGAN

Looking for a newly designs, custom countertop for your kitchen or bathroom? Then you are in luck because we have some of the best counter installation contractors available! We can install just about any type of countertop that you are looking for, though our most requested counters are granite countertops and quartz countertops.

There is no space in your home that we cannot custom design a countertop for. Whether it is a bathroom or kitchen counter, a kitchen island, cocktail bar, or seating nook, we are certain that we can handle your project and leave you 100% satisfied every step of the way.

What is the difference between granite and quartz countertops?

That is a great question and common among our customers and can be quite confusing due to their similarities in look. In short, granite countertops are cut from a solid piece of stone. And quartz countertops are manufactured from crushed quartz and bound together with a resin.

Both options have their side of the debate and will last you well over 25-30 years which makes them both a winner in our opinion. Granite seems to be more prone to chipping or cracking and required sealing and resealing periodically throughout the life of the countertop. Quartz is not free from chipping or cracking, but does not need to be sealed like granite.

When we discuss your project with you and take a look at your room(s), we will help you understand the benefits of the types of countertops you are considering as well as how we would design them custom for your situation before installation.

We can also help you pick out the perfect hardware, sinks, and faucets should your project require these items. After we are completed with your project, we are certain that you will want to take many pictures and share them on Pinterest. And we would also understand why!
